Define a process model for fit_models()

Source: R/models.R
wsva_model.Rd

A model spec says how to turn a basin's inputs into a simulation closure and what to calibrate. Built-in specs: wsva_models(). Add your own with register_model().

Usage

wsva_model(
  id,
  name,
  bounds,
  build,
  requires = c("prcp_mm", "tmean_c", "pet_mm"),
  n_evals_mult = 1,
  package = NA_character_,
  reference = NA_character_
)

Arguments

id

Short id used in fit_models(models = ...) (e.g. "gr4j").

name

Display name.

bounds

Calibration bounds (param_bounds()).

build

function(x, n_layers) returning function(params) -> daily flow (mm/day) aligned with x$daily. x is list(daily, static, hypso); x$daily meets the forcing contract (R/forcing.R) and has pet_mm.

requires

Columns of x$daily the model reads (checked before fitting).

n_evals_mult

Multiplier on the DDS budget (more parameters, more runs).

package

Package the model needs (checked when it is used), or NA.

reference

Citation.

Value

A wsva_model.
